reviewFindings: CRITICAL: windows.rs:68,583 — JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_PROCESS_MEMORY flag never set in LimitFlags; ProcessMemoryLimit is silently ignored by kernel (MSDN-documented)
CRITICAL: windows.rs:635-639 — no argv quoting for CreateProcessAsUserW command line; spaces/special chars in args corrupt or inject tokens
CRITICAL: windows.rs:536 — SetHandleInformation Result unchecked; compiler warns unused_must_use; pipe inheritance may silently fail causing deadlock
HIGH: windows.rs:108-112 — proc_handle from OpenProcess intentionally leaked; MSDN confirms closing it does NOT break job association
HIGH: windows.rs:312 — firewall rule name keyed by PID; concurrent spawns from same process produce identical names causing collision
HIGH: windows.rs:621-635 — job/token handles leak if create_restricted_token or create_pipe fails; no cleanup guard for kernel handles
HIGH: mod.rs:205 + windows.rs:48-114 — apply_rlimits/STASHED_JOB/attach_to_child are dead code on Windows (superseded by spawn_sandboxed broker)
MEDIUM: oracle-core/Cargo.toml:61 — Linux ort fallback missing api-24 feature; FINAL plan calls this a blocker
MEDIUM: projects.rs:8849 — #[cfg(target_os = macos)] added to non-platform-specific test, hides Windows regressions
MEDIUM: agentic_tools.rs:1014-1024 — Unix-only env vars (HOME, USER, SHELL) forwarded to Windows children without adaptation
